source: Technology Promotion Project to Increase Productivity Around Tonle Sap (TSTD — TA 7305-CAM), watermelon (ដំណាំឪឡឹក) technical training booklet, prepared by the project's agricultural techniques and extension officer in cooperation with East West Seed International, November 2016. Contact: livleanghy@gmail.com
text:
Seed selection should consider the variety and match it to how the beds have been prepared. Watermelon seedlings can be raised in two ways: pre-germinating the seed before sowing, or sowing the seed directly into a nursery tray/pot without pre-germination.

Pre-germination method: wrap the seeds in a moist cloth, keeping the cloth damp, and periodically add water so the cloth stays moist until the seeds sprout. Once sprouted, the seeds are picked out and sown one at a time into prepared nursery trays or planting containers filled with the nursery soil mix.

Direct-sowing method: seeds are sown straight into the nursery tray or pot filled with the prepared soil mix without a separate pre-germination step.

After sowing, the germinating seeds/young seedlings should be kept under the shaded nursery shelter and watered appropriately until they are ready for transplanting to the field.
